title: The Adventures of Captain Durag
description: Slime City is a hot mess. Good thing Captain Durag isn’t a crime fighter; he’s a grime fighter. He really knows how to take out the trash.
quote: Looks like it’s time for me to make a clean sweep.
altHero: Captain Durag, a Black superhero in purple
alt1: a dumpster villain with green slime in his mouth
alt3: Captain Durag across a rooftop from the dumpster
